zones.title: Move gate
zones.body: Rules in order: already moved; no appointment in hand; the slot was not offered in this call; not confirmed (state CONFIRM with this slotId read back). Only Proceed moves.

zones.title: Move
zones.body: POST reschedule on the DealerBook booking id keeps the id and the reference code; movedAt, the new slot and state MOVED on the session.

panels.title: AR-26 MoveAppointment
panels.body: Rescheduling keeps the DealerBook booking id and the reference code and moves the timeslot (endpoint sheet, 2026-10-23: timeslots for the booking's offer, then POST reschedule; host api-dev there, open). Same two-turn gate as a booking. DealerBook confirms the move to the customer.
